Definition: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray
BiblicalUsage: Pâlal is to intercede, to intervene, to pray. Hannah prays in bitterness of soul and weeps sore, Solomon asks the LORD to have respect unto the prayer of His servant, God promises that if His people humble themselves and pray He will hear from heaven, and Daniel prays and makes confession to the LORD his God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prayer is not a last resort but an intervention. Hannah, Solomon, Daniel, and a humbled nation all step between need and God, and God answers.
